title: 第一章 你们就吃这个第二章 我才不挺香的
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
“……婆婆？婆婆你没事吧？”
耳边响起带着担忧的声音，叶晚秋努力睁开眼，对上一双盛满焦急的清亮眸子。
“醒了醒了！”
“没事了大师姐，我就说你不用担心，我给她喂了刚炼制出来的固元丹，人肯定没事！”
一道道声音传进耳朵，叶晚秋眼前的景象慢慢变得清晰。
围在她身边的人个个穿着古装剧里的长袍，袖子又大又宽，周身仙气飘飘，模样一个比一个俊。
她不是被雷劈中死了吗？难道这里是天堂？
叶晚秋掐了一把自己的大腿，疼……没死？
她抓住距离自己最近的女生的手，问：“姑娘，你们这是在拍戏吧？我是不是给你们添麻烦了？导演呢？对不住，实在是对不住啊。”
“拍戏？”游星微微蹙眉，眼里浮现几分迷茫。
但她很快整理好表情，将事情的经过讲给她听。
“婆婆，在下凌霄剑派大弟子游星，近日和师弟师妹下山历练，听闻此处有山妖作祟，于是赶来将其斩杀，正要回宗门复命时遇到了昏迷的你……”
在对方的讲述中，叶晚秋脑子更乱了，她好像跟女儿喜欢看的那电视剧里的女主一样，穿越了。
叶晚秋今年五十八，一儿一女，虽然家里没什么大钱，但胜在家庭和睦，生活算得上美满。
可就在昨天她带着小孙女去超市买糖时，看到丈夫在广场上牵着另一个女人跳舞，两人姿态亲昵，她上前理论，对方直接坦白，说跟她没有感情，要和她离婚。
叶晚秋当场气笑，结果那一双儿女也说她无理取闹，最好识相点签了离婚证成全那对奸夫淫妇。
叶晚秋不同意，被几人赶出家门，雷雨将她浇了个透，还把她劈死了。
然后叶晚秋就到了这个地方——类似于仙侠剧里的修仙界。
此刻她面前这些人，就是所谓的修仙者。
距离她最近的这个姑娘叫游星，是凌霄剑派的大师姐，站在她身后的是师弟崔向阳，一直没说话的是陈湛，最后那大眼睛姑娘是小师妹夏景景。

这修仙的就是跟普通人不一样，长得真好看。
“婆婆，你家住哪里？怎么会一个人出现在这儿？”游星问。
她语气温和，脸上神色温柔，平复了叶晚秋心里那股气愤。
“我家在很远的地方，我……我那丈夫死了，儿子闺女也没了，就剩下我一个人。”
叶晚秋心想只是一群白眼狼而已，算什么亲人？还不如当他们死了。
闻言，游星几人脸色凝重下来。
看到叶晚秋满身狼狈地出现在这里，尽管几人心里有了个大概，却依旧难掩失落。
如果他们来得再早一点，是不是这位婆婆的亲人就不会出事了……
“对不住婆婆，提到了你的伤心事。”
叶晚秋摇头，露出一个释然的笑：“都过去了，以后我一个人好好过。”
虽然现在莫名其妙来到了这个地方，但养她自己一个人比养那一大家子白眼狼容易多了。
她看向游星，问：“姑娘，你知不知道离这里最近的镇子怎么走？”
content_en:
"...Mother-in-law? Mother-in-law, are you okay?"
Hearing a worried voice in his ears, Ye Wanqiu tried his best to open his eyes and met a pair of clear eyes filled with anxiety.
"Wake up, wake up!"
"It's okay, Senior Sister. I told her not to worry. I gave her the newly refined Gu Yuan Dan. She must be fine!"
Sounds passed into his ears one after another, and the scene in front of Ye Wanqiu slowly became clear.
The people around her were all wearing robes from costume dramas, with big and wide sleeves, and their whole bodies were full of fairy spirit. Each one looked more handsome than the other.
Wasn't she struck by lightning and died? Could this be heaven?
Ye Wanqiu pinched his thigh. It hurt... didn't he die?
She grabbed the hand of the girl closest to her and asked: "Girls, are you filming a movie? Did I cause you trouble? Where is the director? I'm sorry, I really can't."
"Filming?" You Xing frowned slightly, a bit confused in his eyes.
But she quickly straightened her expression and told her what happened.
"Mother-in-law, I am the eldest disciple of the Lingxiao Sword Sect, You Xing. I recently went down the mountain with my junior brothers and sisters to practice. I heard that there was a mountain demon causing trouble here, so I came to kill it. I was about to return to the sect when I met you who was unconscious..."
As the other party told her, Ye Wanqiu's mind became even more confused. She seemed to have traveled through time just like the heroine in the TV series her daughter liked to watch.
Ye Wanqiu is fifty-eight this year and has a son and a daughter. Although the family does not have a lot of money, it is better to have a harmonious family and a happy life.
But just yesterday, when she took her granddaughter to the supermarket to buy candy, she saw her husband leading another woman to dance in the square. The two were intimate. She approached her to argue, but the other woman directly confessed that he had no feelings for her and wanted to divorce her.
Ye Wanqiu laughed angrily on the spot, but the pair of children also said that she was being unreasonable and it was better for her to sign the divorce certificate to satisfy the adulterer and the adulterous couple.
Ye Wanqiu disagreed and was kicked out of the house by several people. A thunderstorm soaked her and even hacked her to death.
Then Ye Wanqiu arrived at this place - similar to the world of cultivating immortals in Xianxia dramas.
The people in front of her at this moment are the so-called immortal cultivators.
The girl closest to her is called You Xing, the senior sister of Lingxiao Sword Sect. Standing behind her is junior brother Cui Xiangyang, the one who has been silent is Chen Zhan, and the last girl with big eyes is junior sister Xia Jingjing.
This cultivator is different from ordinary people, he is really good-looking.
"Mother-in-law, where do you live? Why are you here alone?" Yusei asked.
Her gentle tone and gentle look on her face calmed the anger in Ye Wanqiu's heart.
"My home is far away. I...my husband is dead, my son and daughter are gone, and I am the only one left."
Ye Wanqiu thought they were just a bunch of white-eyed wolves, what kind of relatives could they be? Might as well treat them as dead.
Hearing this, Yu Xing and others' expressions became solemn.
Seeing Ye Wanqiu appearing here in a state of embarrassment, even though several people had an idea in their minds, they still couldn't hide their disappointment.
If they had come earlier, nothing would have happened to the mother-in-law's relatives...
"I'm sorry, mother-in-law, for mentioning your sadness."
Ye Wanqiu shook his head and showed a relieved smile: "It's all over. I will live well by myself from now on."
Although she came to this place inexplicably now, it is much easier to raise her alone than to raise that big family of white-eyed wolves.
She looked at Yusei and asked, "Girl, do you know how to get to the nearest town from here?"
